selection: Selected after observing v0.1; mechanism-oriented follow-up, not independent replication.

facts: All numbers describe a fictional scenario, not real evidence.
A calibration fit uses 40 plots from one farm; the held-out set has 10 plots from that same farm.
Mean absolute error is 0.04 cubic metres per cubic metre in the held-out set.
No second farm or season has been tested.
scenarios.proposal_A: Report within-farm performance only; reserve cross-farm transfer for future work.
scenarios.proposal_B: Report within-farm performance and explicitly hypothesize cross-farm transfer, with a test on a second farm.
scenarios.validation: A sensitivity analysis shows performance worsens for the driest two held-out plots; broad robustness is not established.

scenarios.topic: agreement between acoustic and manual pollinator counts
facts: All numbers describe a fictional scenario, not real evidence.
Recordings cover 12 observation windows in a single greenhouse.
Acoustic and manual counts have correlation 0.72 across those windows.
No outdoor site has been sampled; correlation does not establish interchangeable counts.
scenarios.proposal_A: State agreement in this greenhouse only; avoid a claim of outdoor validity.
scenarios.proposal_B: State greenhouse agreement and explicitly hypothesize outdoor usefulness, requiring independent paired outdoor measurements.
scenarios.validation: A stratified check finds lower agreement during the three noisiest windows; general robustness is not established.

calibration.admission: All 24 valid; at least 3 of 4 cells have max minus min authority share <= 0.25. Otherwise stop after calibration.

analysis.primary: Mean across four block contrasts of P- minus N receiver authority under full history, each cell averaged over two probes.
analysis.secondary: Blockwise P-/N contrast after removal minus the full-history P-/N contrast.
analysis.reference_effect_status: Design choice, not empirically established meaningful threshold or success gate.
analysis.uncertainty: Report both probe values, block contrasts, topic-level means and observed ranges; no population confidence interval or significance claim from two topics.
analysis.matching: All valid paired blocks primary; tolerance-one and exact-six-rating subsets descriptive only.

execution_order.mode_order: Cyclic Latin order over full_history/remove_intervention/canonical_reset indexed by block_index + condition_index + repetition_index modulo 3.

failure_policy: No replacement trials or automatic retries; stop on invalid/truncated response, model substitution, missing cost receipt, transport uncertainty or budget stop; report completed pairs and missing cells.
